item.title: Rains and storms batter parts of US: Flash flood warning issued across New York City; state of emergency declared in New Jersey
item.description: Heavy rainfall triggered flash flood warnings across New York City and prompted New Jersey to declare a state of emergency. The rising water levels disrupted roads, airports, and public transport services. Residents were urged to stay indoors as the slow-moving storm system is expected to move south, increasing the flood risk for regions from North Carolina to southern New Jersey.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'They just bombed a nursing home': Trump claims Melania's remarks pushed for stronger action on Russia; US president pledges billions for Ukraine
item.description: US President Trump revealed that First Lady Melania played a crucial role in influencing his tougher stance against Putin regarding the Russia-Ukraine war. Melania questioned Trump's optimistic views after his calls with Putin, citing ongoing attacks.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Trump tariffs: US slaps 17% duty on Mexican tomato imports; commerce department calls move fair protection for farmers
item.description: The US government has imposed a 17% import duty on most fresh tomatoes from Mexico. This decision aims to protect the American tomato industry. Talks between US and Mexican officials failed to reach a new agreement. The duty took effect immediately. It is expected to raise tomato prices in the US. American growers are likely to benefit from this move.
item.dc:creator: TOI Business Desk

item.title: Ro Khanna pushes for release of Epstein client list, asks who are the rich persons being protected
item.description: Democrat Rep. Ro Khanna plans to introduce an amendment to the GENIUS Act, compelling Attorney General Pam Bondi to release Jeffrey Epstein's client list. This move comes amid growing pressure on the Trump administration regarding the Epstein case. Rep. Mark Veasey is also introducing a resolution demanding the files' release, hinting at a potential cover-up.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'In it to win it': Andrew Cuomo will remain in NYC mayor's race even after primary loss, Zohran Mamdani says he doesn't care because...
item.description: Andrew Cuomo, after his primary defeat to Zohran Mamdani, plans to run as an independent, pledging to withdraw if he isn't the strongest challenger by early September. He urges other independent candidates to do the same. Mamdani's campaign dismisses Cuomo's efforts, calling them backroom deals with billionaires and Republicans.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Where is Ghislaine Maxwell now? Is she the only one who can disclose Epstein's client list?
item.description: Ghislaine Maxwell, convicted of sex trafficking, reportedly desires to testify before Congress, claiming her innocence in the Epstein case. Sources reveal she was never approached despite her willingness. ​Maxwell is considered one of the few people who could reveal the secrets of Epstein. Like Epstein's brother Mark Epstein, Maxwell also believed that Epstein did not commit suicide and was murdered.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ​'What's wrong with the shape of your head': Minneapolis mayoral candidate Omar Fateh faces racist trolling; 'Go to Mogadishu'
item.description: Somalian-American Minnesota state senator Omar Fateh faced racist attacks on social media as he laid out plans for his Minneapolis mayoral candidacy. Fateh, a Democrat, pledged to raise the minimum wage and limit police interaction with ICE. Critics questioned his citizenship, made hateful comments about his Somali heritage, and compared him unfavorably to Zohran Mamdani, accusing him of promoting a 'multi-cultural Marxist' agenda.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Annus Chaoticus: From trumping death to celebrating Chelsea's win – a year in Donald Trump’s life
item.description: A year ago, Donald trumped death, defying the laws of space, time, physics, politics, and logic as he did something that had been done only once before in American history: return to the White House after a hiatus. And not just any break — a five-year, scandal-scarred interregnum that included two impeachments, a Capitol riot, multiple indictments, and that gloriously capitalist moment when Trump, now with his own mugshot, began selling it as an NFT and framed it in the White House like it was a Warhol.
item.dc:creator: Nirmalya Dutta

item.title: US-born Indians are embracing their country of origin now more than before, claims report
item.description: A recent report indicates that Indian-Americans, particularly those born in the US, are increasingly embracing their Indian heritage, identifying strongly with both Indian and American identities. The survey reveals a growing connection to Indian culture through food, entertainment, and arts. The survey was conducted online over 1206 Indian-American adults by polling firm YouGov, including both US citizens and non-citizen respondents.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Emotionally exhausted, physically burned out': Indian-origin Canadian recounts ordeal, pharmacy degree-holder had to do hotel jobs
item.description: Keerthy Vinukonda, an Indian-origin Canadian, shared her challenging journey to Canadian citizenship. Despite holding a pharmacy degree from India, she faced hardships, working long hours in hotel jobs to gain Canadian work experience. Vinukonda highlights the disparity between immigration firms' promises and the realities faced by newcomers, emphasizing the need for realistic perspectives on immigrating to Canada.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Qatar to compensate residents affected by debris after Iranian missile strike; 2-day deadline to submit claims
item.description: Qatar has initiated a compensation program for citizens and residents whose properties were damaged by debris from intercepted Iranian missiles targeting the Al Udeid US base during the June Iran-Israel conflict. Following directives from the Amir, the government is processing claims through the Civil Defence Council, with affected individuals required to submit documentation via the Metrash app within two days.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: What is Emirates ID: How to get it, process, application, benefits, everything explained
item.description: This guide explains everything you need to know about the Emirates ID, including its purpose, benefits, and how to apply. Whether you’re a UAE citizen, expat, or GCC national, the Emirates ID is essential for accessing government services, healthcare, banking, and more. Learn the step-by-step process and why this card matters for daily life in the UAE.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Times Square ad war: Vivek Ramaswamy fights Zohran Mamdani but says don't attack his ethnicity
item.description: A Times Square ad war erupted, urging New Yorkers to flee a potential Zohran Mamdani mayoral victory for Ohio, where Vivek Ramaswamy is running for governor in 2026. The ad contrasts Mamdani's "radical socialist" views with Ramaswamy's promise of "protecting freedom. The ad is paid for by Vivek's PAC, but Vivek's suggestion to Mamdani critics is not to attack Mamdani for his ethnicity, but for his worldview.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Ghislaine Maxwell didn't hang herself next week': Chilling predictions on social media after she says she will disclose 'Epstein client list'
item.description: Ghislaine Maxwell, convicted on child sex trafficking charges, has expressed her willingness to disclose information about Jeffrey Epstein's secrets and client list as the Trump administration closed the case. Social media users have voiced concerns about her safety, drawing parallels to Epstein's suicide and accuser Virginia Giuffre's death. In 2019, Giuffre asserted she was not suicidal, yet she ended her life in 2025.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: UAE: Over 3.5 million illegal excise goods found hidden in clothing shipments during major FTA raid in Dubai
item.description: The UAE's Federal Tax Authority (FTA) seized over 3.5 million illegal excise goods, including cigarettes, e-smoking devices, and tobacco products, hidden in clothing shipments during a major raid in Dubai. Valued at AED 133.2 million (approx. USD 36.27 million) in unpaid taxes, the operation is part of FTA’s efforts to combat tax evasion and enforce compliance.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Happiest place but...: Video of JD Vance running at 'woke' Disneyland viral amid heckling, protests
item.description: Vice President JD Vance's Disneyland visit became controversial due to protests over ICE raids and his past criticism of Disney. Jane Fleming Kleeb confronted him about his alleged dislike for California. A video of Vance awkwardly running after his child went viral, drawing mockery online. While Vance ignored most of the trolling and protests, he clapped back at California Governor Gavin Newsom.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Club World Cup: How Donald Trump crashed Chelsea's party - and refused to leave the stage
item.description: And then came the moment that defined the day: as Chelsea’s captain Reece James prepared to lift the trophy, Trump remained in the centre of the stage, refusing to step aside. Infantino quietly moved out of the camera frame. Trump stayed put, flanked by Chelsea players and global dignitaries, ensuring that when Chelsea were crowned world champions, he too was in the picture.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk
